entries.5fe76725b7ce8a4e: The company was founded in 1967 in Neyagawa, Osaka Prefecture. Its head office is in Kyotanabe, Kyoto Prefecture, and it is listed on the Standard Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange. The number of employees as of March 31, 2026 was 596, and it has four consolidated subsidiaries.
entries.64b450e2ef2465fb: The business manufactures and sells precision forging dies, mainly used for cold forging. It sells mainly to automotive parts manufacturers, and NICHIDAI U.S.A. CORPORATION in the United States and NICHIDAI ASIA CO.,LTD. in Thailand also sell the company's products. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥4,467 million.
entries.6c4dd9f62877c15c: By revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026, the Mold Business was the largest at ¥4,467 million, followed by the Precision Parts Business at ¥4,244 million and the Filter Business at ¥2,280 million. Revenue from Mitsubishi Heavy Industries Group, its main customer, accounts for 26.9% of total revenue.
entries.7d0d36ec6e3eab99: A company that manufactures and sells precision forging dies for automotive parts manufacturers, turbocharger parts, and industrial sintered metal filters.
entries.9455679e14d33fac: Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥10,992 million, comprising ¥4,467 million from the Mold Business, ¥4,244 million from the Precision Parts Business and ¥2,280 million from the Filter Business. This was a 5.3% decrease from the previous fiscal year.
entries.94f88a2f02732202: It manufactures and sells precision forging dies mainly used in cold forging, precision components such as turbocharger parts and scroll compressor parts for air conditioners, and sintered metal filters used in the petrochemical, pharmaceutical, food and nuclear fields.
entries.c0fa86671bbfa15a: This business model manufactures precision forging dies for cold forging, precision components such as turbocharger parts, and sintered metal filters, and sells them to automotive parts makers in Japan and overseas.
entries.d5bb255b6fabe45a: Its basic management policy is to aim to be a company that maximizes customer, shareholder and employee satisfaction and creates new value to contribute to society, and it aims to be an only-one company that pursues “products that others cannot make and high technological capability that others cannot match.” Its medium-term management strategy, “ＣＨＡＮＧＥ～Nichinovation 2026～,” which started in fiscal 2022, sets out customer value creation with the ＶＳＯＰ spirit, building a company where employees can keep shining, and contributing to a sustainable society, and it is advancing the strengthening of proposal capability through the application and evolution of core technologies, the strengthening of global strategy, and expansion into new businesses and fields.
entries.d7010bffc5e69004: It sells molds and precision parts mainly to automotive parts manufacturers, and sells filters to customers in fields such as petrochemicals, pharmaceuticals, food and nuclear power.
